entry.title: Essential Adjacent References
entry.summary:
Data analysis often involves cross-row calculations, such as Link Relative Ratio (LRR), Year-over-Year (YoY) and moving averages. Implementing cross-row calculations on ordered datasets will involve the issue of referencing adjacent members within a set. For example, a merchant has prepared its sales data for 12 months of a year, arranged by month, and now wants to calculate the maximum monthly growth. Code in SQL: with sales as ( select column_value as amount, rownum as month from table(sys.odcinumberlist(123,345,321,345,546,542,874,234,543,983,434,897)) ), lagged_sales as ( select amount, month, lag(amount) over (order by month) as prev from sales ) select max(amount - prev) as max from lagged_sales;
